summary: A field carries the words and limits its control needs -- the call to action and the readable formats of a file field, the accept list its dialog filters by, a placeholder, a search placeholder, a badge appearance, a readonly mark. All of them are the host's, and an answer carrying them is applied.

then.note: This case exists because the field schema is closed. A host that validates its own answers against this port was refused for sending uploadText, formats and accept -- keys the renderer set has always read but the port never declared, which is the port lying about the seam rather than the host getting it wrong. A field control with no words of its own falls back to the component's default, and a file control's default names image formats, which is wrong for a field that takes any file.
